newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring harvest stalls.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring harvest stalls.

text.p: A wet weekend in the U.S. Northern Plains stalled the spring wheat harvest, pushing MGE September wheat futures sharply higher and prompting some country locations to raise basis bids, cash dealers said.

"It's going to rain again any minute now," a northern Montana dealer said. "So far there's no damage but it's holding up harvest. There's guys who have trains to load and they're jacking their bids up some."
Weekend rains fell across Montana, North Dakota and Minnesota and more rain was expected to move through the area in the next few days, dealers said.
The U.S. Agriculture Department said Monday that the spring wheat harvest was 22 percent complete as of Sunday, below the 29 percent last year at this time but just sbehind the average of 23 percent.
Quality was of growing concern in North Dakota where there were reports of scab damage. The latest round of wet weather may have exacerbated the disease problems, a Minnesota dealer said.
